doctrine: ADR-039 fix-and-disclose: presentation-layer improvement is ordinary disclosed correction (edit_status + edits[]); values never invented. wave-20 machinery stands: stemFigures carry the eyeballed crop boxes for the stem-figure tranche (crop-required stub -> F45 manual_crop render); dropTail/dropSpan remove flattened figure-label soup that the crop now serves visually; stemFigureRef inlines an already-cropped figure. Anchors disclosed, fail-disclosed. Group-stem keys (Q<n>.<letter>, F121) restore the question-group intro to the group's first part: same verdict vocabulary + dropSpan/dropTail cuts + mechanical cleaning; a group entry may declare figures[] (asset ids rendered after the group stem, print order restored); fail-closed anchors; slice-scoped consumption (G-E7). Part-level keys (Q<n>.<g>(<i>), F125) adjudicate the same flattened-soup class living in a part's OWN problem_md: same cut law (the cut removes only what a crop of record serves — served_by must resolve to a crop asset of that part), fail-closed verbatim anchors, slice-scoped consumption (G-E7); cropRect records the eyeballed re-crop box when the wave re-cropped the serving asset.
